risk_summary: The excerpt presents meaningful operational and financial risks, including customer delivery deferrals, elevated inventory, supply-chain constraints, fixed-price contracts, higher borrowing costs, and potential customer payment delays. Management uses confident forward-looking language to frame delays as temporary while emphasizing strong backlog and 2025 growth prospects. Quantified revenue impacts and reconciliation disclosures improve transparency, although extensive risk boilerplate and non-GAAP adjustments somewhat soften the negative performance narrative.
